sara_cs: Sharing a compact 'Onboard Action Card' for accounts where renewals are at-risk because of slow first-call latency or quality blips. Aim: customer-facing, one page they can follow. Draft link: https://redwood.example/runbooks/action-card (preview)

sara_cs: Sections: TL;DR checklist, server + client batching recipes, streaming fallback pattern, quick telemetry contract, renewal check-in template, escalation path.

pete_se: love the one-pager idea. can we include a tiny server-side batch example (python) customers can drop into a lambda?

sara_cs: added a minimal snippet under "Server batching (drop-in)":

sara_cs: ```py
# simple server batcher sketch
buffer = []
def enqueue(req):
    buffer.append(req)
    if len(buffer) >= 16:
        flush()

def flush():
    batch = buffer[:16]
    buffer[:] = buffer[16:]
    resp = call_redwood(batch)
    return resp
```

ana_pm: for streaming fallback, can we recommend a progressive UI that shows partial results and a throttle indicator? also mention when to switch to smaller model variant.

mike_solutions: include UX copy suggestion: "Were loading a fast preview (may be partial). Full result arriving shortly." prevents users from thinking the app is broken.

sara_cs: good call — added UX copy + a rule: after 1.2s with no token, show preview state; after 3s start returning cached summary and surface a "Try again" action.

ops-bot: event: runbook_publish by sara_cs at 2026-03-22T16:02:00Z

pete_se: what's the telemetry contract for warmup and ongoing health? add the minimal schema here so CS can paste into account onboarding notes.

sara_cs: paste telemetry we settled on: compact JSON event (store as string in runbook):

sara_cs: {"event":"onboard_health","tenant_id":"<tenant>","phase":"prefill|steady","prefill_ok":true,"p50_ms":"120","p95_ms":"220","prefill_batch":"8","stream_fallback_used":false} 

ana_pm: for renewal conversations, i want a single-sentence prompt for AE to open the call that focuses on risk: "We saw XX% of your initial calls exceed the SLA during onboarding; would you like us to run a prioritized warmup before renewal?"

mike_solutions: add a low-friction ask: offer a 30-minute warmup ops call + sandboxed prefill run (no charge) — good incentive for high-value accounts.

sara_cs: included and added a 3-question survey to capture feedback after warmup: 1) Did performance improve? (yes/no) 2) Any quality regression? (free text) 3) Satisfaction 1-10. responses go to #cs-warmup-feedback and append to account timeline.

pete_se: any automatic triggers here? e.g., create a PS ticket if p95>300ms for 15m or if prefill_ok=false twice in 24h.

sara_cs: yes: rule -> if p95>300ms for 15m OR prefill_ok=false for 2 checks in 24h -> create ticket to "customer-success-escalations" and auto-run a targeted warm-pool prefill job. documented runbook step included.

ops-bot: runbook:onboard-action-card published to customer-success channel by sara_cs :white_check_mark:

sara_cs: thanks team — planning to send to AEs tomorrow morning. drop a quick :thumbsup: or inline edits.
